rule: Ids are append-only (supersede, never delete). Each requirement traces to acceptance criteria and tests (master §13, §40). The 11 original ids are umbrella requirements: they are GREEN only when every requirement that cites them in its source is closed.

requirements.description: Project state must be recoverable from repository artifacts without chat history.
acceptance: A fresh session reading only README_FIRST's list writes a bootstrap assertion that scripts/agent/bootstrap-check.mjs accepts
node scripts/agent/check-state.mjs exits 0 on the S0 checkpoint
STATE.json, LEDGER.jsonl, HANDOFF.md and the S0 evidence manifest agree with Git

requirements.description: No mutating remote action before explicit owner approval.
acceptance: No push, PR, GitHub write, workflow run, deploy (GitHub Pages or Render) or publish happens without an owner approval recorded verbatim in an ADR
Every session-end check (relaunch.mjs) finds no 'update by push' reflog entry and unchanged remotes

requirements.description: Implement approved mobile tab bar, More sheet and hash-route navigation contract.
acceptance: Every NAV requirement sourced from design §5-§6 or master §9 S1 is GREEN

requirements.description: Implement approved genetics expansion and disclosure experience without unnecessary genetics-engine rewrite.
acceptance: Every GEN requirement sourced from design §8-§9 or master §9 S2 is GREEN
src/sim/life/genetics.ts is extended, not restructured (design §3.2)

requirements.description: Implement approved shop filters, offer detail and purchase-fit behavior.
acceptance: Every MKT requirement sourced from design §7 or master §9 S2 is GREEN

requirements.description: Implement maintenance automation and Auto Water Changer deterministically.
acceptance: Every AUTO requirement sourced from design §10 or master §9 S3-A is GREEN
core-determinism and fix-core-step-invariance stay green

requirements.source: master §9 S3-D; ADR-0001 (option C); ADR-0002 decision 4
requirements.description: Implement deep local aquarium/aquaculture automation beyond simple maintenance toggles.
acceptance: Every AUTO requirement sourced from master §9 S3-D is GREEN or closed by an owner-approved ADR
DESIGN-S3D is APPROVED before any owner-visible S3-D surface is built

requirements.description: Implement multiple deterministic production lines per species.
acceptance: Every PROD requirement is GREEN
Two lines for the same species run side by side without sharing a creature, clutch or listing

requirements.description: Implement truthful web notifications and approved quiet-hours/category behavior.
acceptance: Every NOTIFY requirement sourced from design §12 or master §9 S3-B is GREEN
No copy promises alerts while the game is closed

requirements.description: Implement the complete local SocialService stub experience.
acceptance: Every SOC requirement sourced from design §13 or master §9 S4 is GREEN

requirements.description: Stop at Multiplayer Readiness Gate and require explicit owner approval before real multiplayer.
acceptance: After S4 acceptance the state reaches MULTIPLAYER_READINESS_GATE, then OWNER_GATE (reason MULTIPLAYER)
No backend, account, cloud-save or real trading code exists without an owner-approved ADR

requirements.description: Each session ends at a mega-slice boundary or early-rollover point; the owner starts the next one with KICKOFF.md, or the opt-in relaunch.mjs does.
acceptance: relaunch.mjs never starts a session when STOP exists, check-state fails, the state is a stop state, remote mutation is allowed or the branch isn't the integration branch
relaunch.mjs stops on a non-zero exit, no progress, any stop state, the session cap, a detected push, changed remotes or changed deploy configuration
bootstrap-check.mjs rejects an assertion from the session that closed the previous slice

requirements.description: Designs enter through the registry and intake procedure, and work that depends on a design starts only once it is APPROVED.
acceptance: DESIGN_REGISTRY.json lists DESIGN-0.5 (APPROVED, with its overrides) and DESIGN-S3D (PENDING_OWNER_DESIGN)
check-state.mjs rejects an APPROVED design without an approval reference or an existing path

requirements.description: Owner approvals are valid only when the owner's own words are recorded verbatim in an ADR, and remote or multiplayer permission can't be set without one.
acceptance: check-state.mjs fails when remoteMutationAllowed or multiplayerApproved is true without an existing ADR reference
record-event.mjs refuses to leave OWNER_GATE or BLOCKED_MANUAL_REVIEW without a decision reference

requirements.description: Evidence is tamper-evident and tied to the code it judged: logs hashed and committed, gates bound to a code tree, tests inventoried, protected files hashed.
acceptance: check-state.mjs fails on a GREEN gate without a passing run on the accepted code tree, on edited or ignored evidence, on a rewritten ledger line and on a deleted requirement id
test-inventory.mjs fails when a test id disappears, the count drops or a skip marker appears
protect.mjs fails when a protected file changes without --update --adr

requirements.description: The objective gates can be trusted: e2e never tests a foreign server, e2e specs are typechecked, tests must assert, and focused tests can't pass a gate.
acceptance: playwright.config.ts reuses a running server only with E2E_REUSE=1 (a busy port fails)
tsconfig.json includes tests/e2e and playwright.config.ts, and npm run typecheck passes
vitest.config.ts sets allowOnly: false and expect.requireAssertions: true, and npm test passes
playwright.config.ts sets forbidOnly: true

requirements.description: The release step is prepared but not executed: package.json stays at its current version, user-facing notes go under '## Unreleased' in CHANGELOG.md, and the owner package proposes the version, changelog entry and What's new copy.
acceptance: package.json version and the newest versioned CHANGELOG heading are unchanged until the owner approves a release plan (tests/sim/version.test.ts stays green)
The owner package contains the proposed version, CHANGELOG entry and What's new list

requirements.description: A v0.4.0 save still loads at the end of every slice, with repairs: [] unless an owner-approved ADR changes the save policy.
acceptance: A committed v0.4.0 fixture save loads with repairs: [] at each slice's acceptance

requirements.description: repairState is idempotent and two save/load round trips keep the stateHash, for a fresh game, a legacy save and the big facility fixture.
acceptance: repairState applied twice gives an equal stateHash
load → save → load keeps the stateHash

requirements.description: No SCHEMA_VERSION bump without an owner decision; the code that ships must never fall back past, rotate away or overwrite a save written by newer code ('too_new').
acceptance: SCHEMA_VERSION stays 1 unless an owner-approved ADR says otherwise
A too_new save is never replaced by an older backup or overwritten

requirements.description: A crafted or corrupted save can't pollute object prototypes, crash the sim loop or make the game fetch remote URLs.
acceptance: Ids such as __proto__, constructor and toString are rejected or repaired
Listing photos that aren't data:image URLs are dropped on load
requirements.note: Inherited-key ids and non-embedded listing photos fixed in S0 (S0-T8); oversized arrays and number ranges remain for S4 hardening.

requirements.description: Save size stays within a stated budget at maximum scale, so the synchronous localStorage mirror keeps working.
acceptance: A maximum-scale fixture (tanks, creatures, production lines, listing photos) serializes under the budget the S3 contract states

requirements.description: The Social stub never persists a password anywhere: localStorage, IndexedDB, the save or an export.
acceptance: After sign-in and sign-up, no stored value contains the typed password
